transcript: Speaker A: I am mopping the floor. Mopping means cleaning with water. I use a mop. The floor becomes clean and wet. This is a table. I am wiping the table. Wiping means cleaning with a cloth. I use a cloth to clean the table. These are dishes. I am washing the dishes. Washing means cleaning with water. I use water and soap. These are clothes. I am folding the clothes. Folding means making clothes neat. I make them small and tidy. Speaker B: Download now! Start practicing.
